title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E1 — Grand Opening, The-part 1
George's boasting of how well he is doing heads him for a disaster when the underworld gets into the act, in Part I of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E3 — Raymond Burr, Ruth Gordon, Stevie Wonder
Flip, Ruth & Raymond attend the opera; Stevie plays a synthesizer as Flip recites a poem and Ruth visits Charley’s Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E4 — Ruth Buzzi, Tim Conway
Flip, Tim & Ruth do a park bench skit and private eye spoof; Geraldine disrupts the office at her new job.

description:
S2 E4 — Ruth Buzzi, Tim Conway
Flip, Tim & Ruth do a park bench skit and private eye spoof; Geraldine disrupts the office at her new job.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E8 — Jerry Butler
Singer Jerry Butler headlines this episode, together with his back-up group, Peaches.  Highlights of their numbers are "Make It Easy on Yourself" and "Brand New Me".

title: Webster
description:
S1 E1 — Another Ballgame
After the untimely death of a young boy's parents, he is sent to live with his father's best friend.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E12 — Mixed Doubles
It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E13 — Two Guys, A Girl, and a Calendar
Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E14 — Sweet Talk
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E15 — Father's Day
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E16 — I Know What You Did In Drama Class
Diavian and Tyreke become partners in drama class but Tia flips out after catching them in a passionate kiss during a drama rehearsal. Tamera and Jordan try to hook up cable in the girl's room.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E1 — Labor Day Jammy
Mo’s new school’s annual fund-raiser conflicts with Crenshaw High’s final summer blowout “Freaknik”, and Frank and Dee insist Mo should attend the fund-raiser.
